    Project Summary

    Database Schema

    Tables Created

    text
    ✅ users              - User profiles (extends auth.users)
✅ languages          - French, Spanish, English (3 rows)
✅ courses            - Language courses
✅ units              - Chapters within courses
✅ lessons            - Individual lessons
✅ exercises          - Questions/exercises
✅ vocabulary         - Word bank
✅ enrollments        - User-course relationship
✅ lesson_progress    - Track lesson completion
✅ exercise_attempts  - Track exercise answers
✅ user_vocabulary    - Spaced repetition data
✅ achievements       - Badges/rewards (6 default rows)
✅ user_achievements  - Unlocked achievements

Note: Tables exist but are mostly empty (no course content yet)

    Key Table Structures

    SQL
    -- Users (extends Supabase auth)
users
├── id (UUID, from auth.users)
├── email
├── name
├── avatar_url
├── native_language (default 'en')
├── daily_goal_minutes (default 15)
├── total_xp (default 0)
├── current_streak (default 0)
├── longest_streak (default 0)
├── last_activity_date
├── subscription_tier ('FREE' or 'PREMIUM')
├── stripe_customer_id
├── subscription_ends_at
├── role ('USER' or 'ADMIN')
└── created_at, updated_at

-- Courses
courses
├── id (UUID)
├── language_id (FK → languages)
├── title
├── slug (unique)
├── description
├── level ('A1', 'A2', 'B1', 'B2', 'C1', 'C2')
├── course_type ('CORE', 'SKILL', 'TOPIC', 'PRACTICE')
├── image_url
├── estimated_hours
├── total_lessons
├── is_premium
├── is_published
├── order_index
└── created_at, updated_at

-- Lessons
lessons
├── id (UUID)
├── unit_id (FK → units)
├── title
├── slug
├── description
├── lesson_type ('VOCABULARY', 'GRAMMAR', 'READING', etc.)
├── content (JSONB)
├── estimated_minutes
├── xp_reward
├── order_index
├── is_premium
└── created_at, updated_at

-- Exercises
exercises
├── id (UUID)
├── lesson_id (FK → lessons)
├── exercise_type ('MULTIPLE_CHOICE', 'FILL_BLANK', 'MATCHING', 'TRANSLATION')
├── difficulty ('EASY', 'MEDIUM', 'HARD')
├── question
├── content (JSONB - type-specific data)
├── explanation
├── hint
├── xp_reward
├── order_index
└── created_at, updated_at

    Exercise Content JSON Structures

    JSON
    // MULTIPLE_CHOICE
{
  "options": ["Option A", "Option B", "Option C", "Option D"],
  "correct_index": 1
}

// FILL_BLANK
{
  "sentence": "Je ___ français.",
  "blanks": [
    {
      "position": 0,
      "correct_answer": "parle",
      "acceptable_answers": ["parle", "Parle"]
    }
  ]
}

// MATCHING
{
  "pairs": [
    { "left": "Bonjour", "right": "Hello" },
    { "left": "Merci", "right": "Thank you" }
  ]
}

// TRANSLATION
{
  "source_language": "en",
  "target_language": "fr",
  "correct_answers": ["Bonjour", "Salut"]
}

    MVP Learning Structure (Confirmed)

    text
    COURSE STRUCTURE
────────────────

ENTRY POINTS:
├── Placement Test → Suggested level (can skip ahead)
└── "Start from Beginning" → A1 Unit 1

CORE PATH (Sequential Unlock):
French A1 → A2 → B1 → B2
Spanish A1 → A2 → B1 → B2
English A1 → A2 → B1 → B2

UNLOCK RULES:
├── Lessons: Must complete previous lesson (70% score)
├── Units: Must complete all lessons + unit review
├── Courses: Must complete previous level OR pass placement test

FREE vs PREMIUM:
├── Free: Core Path, 3 lessons/day, basic exercises
└── Premium: Unlimited, AI features, Skill Tracks (future)

FUTURE ADDITIONS:
├── Skill Tracks (Grammar, Vocabulary, etc.) - Premium
├── Topic Courses (Travel, Business) - Premium
└── Teacher Portal + Student-Tutor Lessons (separate PDFs)

    Course Outline (French A1)

    text
    FRENCH A1 - FOUNDATIONS
───────────────────────

Unit 1: First Words
├── L1: French Alphabet & Sounds
├── L2: Basic Pronunciation
├── L3: Common Greetings
├── L4: Numbers 1-10
└── L5: Unit Review

Unit 2: Meeting People
├── L1: Introductions
├── L2: Formal vs Informal (tu/vous)
├── L3: Nationalities
├── L4: Numbers 11-20
└── L5: Unit Review

Unit 3: Being & Having
├── L1: Verb "être" (to be)
├── L2: Verb "avoir" (to have)
├── L3: Subject Pronouns
├── L4: Describing Yourself
└── L5: Unit Review

... (10 units total)
